## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --release --workspace` passes from `daemon/`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] No vendor files, firmware dumps, installers, tokens or personal data are included
- [ ] Documentation updated if commands, behaviour or architecture changed
- [ ] No code copied from GPL-3.0, MPL-2.0 or unlicensed projects

## Hardware tested

Was this tested on a real AKP153E? Say **yes** or **no**; if yes, include the firmware version and
what you checked (painting, presses, scenes, plugins). If it was not tested on hardware, say so
explicitly.
